input: Negotiate a raise at my annual review

gold.taskTitle: Negotiate a raise at my annual review
gold.taskDescription: Prepare for and successfully negotiate a salary increase during an upcoming annual performance review.

questions.title: When exactly is your annual review scheduled?
questions.description: Identify the date or timeframe of the review to determine how much preparation time is available.

questions.title: What is your current salary or hourly rate?
questions.description: Establish the baseline compensation figure to anchor the negotiation strategy.

questions.title: What specific raise amount or percentage are you targeting?
questions.description: Clarify the concrete number or range the user wants to achieve from this negotiation.

questions.title: What industry and type of role do you work in?
questions.description: Understand the professional context to tailor market research and negotiation framing appropriately.

questions.title: Have you received any raises or promotions in the past two years?
questions.description: Understand recent compensation history to frame the ask in context of career progression.

questions.title: What is your biggest fear or obstacle about asking?
questions.description: Surface the core concern or blocker that is making this negotiation feel difficult or risky.

questions.title: Has your manager given any signals about your performance lately?
questions.description: Gauge the current relationship and standing with the decision-maker to calibrate negotiation tone and timing.
